sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Zhalia Moon used Farslip to open numerous doors within the Argo whilst searching for the Hoplite Amulets of Jason. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Lok Lambert used the spell to call a lift whilst working as a bellboy. [All Work and No Pay] He again used Farslip to open a drawer in a secret room at the Tomb of Nefertiti, revealing a puzzle left to him by his dad. [The Sceptre Deception]

He later used it to open a hidden passage in an alcove in the Castle of Vlad Dracul, allowing him, Cherit and Sophie Casterwill to escape from Antedeluvian. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Dante Vale used the spell to activate a set of traps in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, defeating Ammit Heart-Eater and Sekhmet. [Memory Lane] He later used the spell to unlock the entrance to Klaus' bookshop. [The Blood Spiral]

Den Fears used the spell to splash Sophie Casterwill with water by firing it at a running sink. [Lok's Leadership]

full_text:
Farslip is a handy Huntik Foundation spell used to open up doors and break locks. It can also activate traps. Very little energy is used to cast this. When cast it emits a green glow from the user's finger, the glow will then enter the object unlocking it.

== History ==
Zhalia Moon used Farslip to open numerous doors within the Argo whilst searching for the Hoplite Amulets of Jason. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Lok Lambert used the spell to call a lift whilst working as a bellboy. [All Work and No Pay] He again used Farslip to open a drawer in a secret room at the Tomb of Nefertiti, revealing a puzzle left to him by his dad. [The Sceptre Deception]

He later used it to open a hidden passage in an alcove in the Castle of Vlad Dracul, allowing him, Cherit and Sophie Casterwill to escape from Antedeluvian. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Dante Vale used the spell to activate a set of traps in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, defeating Ammit Heart-Eater and Sekhmet. [Memory Lane] He later used the spell to unlock the entrance to Klaus' bookshop. [The Blood Spiral]

Den Fears used the spell to splash Sophie Casterwill with water by firing it at a running sink. [Lok's Leadership]
